items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The change is two lines: a clear comment, '# Ensure base table is in aliases.', and a call to an existing, well-named helper. It matches the existing style.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It reuses the existing query.get_initial_alias() helper with minimal, localized change in single_alias. Temporary test files were removed and no debug code was left behind.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: No error-handling surface is touched. get_initial_alias() is idempotent and safe, and nothing is swallowed and no magic constants are added.

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The root cause is fixed in single_alias by registering the base alias before counting. The agent checked that .all() gives 'DELETE FROM "delete_user"' while a joined filter still uses the subquery (U0/U1). There is no backend-specific special case, and hidden tests pass.
